_help: The PRACTICAL TEST area (spec J). PLACEHOLDER: the polygon and the ramp points are NOT surveyed - an instructor (CAPTAIN) sets the real area with the instructor tool (step 21: map taps, boat GPS 'add point', .geojson import; audit-logged). The practical test refuses until a real area is set. This file is NEVER a chart: the shallow-water / route / collision checks use only charts/ (tools/chartprep.py).
name_el: Όρμος Δασκαλειό + ράμπα, Κερατέα (ΠΡΟΣΩΡΙΝΟ - δεν έχει μετρηθεί)
name_en: Daskalio bay + ramp, Keratea (PLACEHOLDER - not surveyed)
_note_polygon: PLACEHOLDER corners [lat, lon] around the bay - replace them with the instructor tool (PROGRESS.md W30)
_note_wind: owner 2026-10-28 (W27): 12 kn; the wind is typed in and confirmed by the examiner
_note_strong: a wind FROM a blocked direction is refused from strong_wind_kn up (8 kn = a default, TO CONFIRM by the owner: PROGRESS.md W39); N = from 315..45 deg; ramp_right = from the right side when looking down the ramp to the sea (the ramp bearing +45..+135 deg)
_note_blocked: spec default: strong north AND from the right side at the ramp (ramp_right = from the right when looking down the ramp to the sea)
_note_photos: chart PHOTOS for the test area picture / demo map / 3D sim ONLY - NOT a navigation chart (docs/daskalio/README.txt)
